changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.scoring ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP(6), product_id BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT fk_scoring_product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES public.product (id) );

changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS stop_factors

changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP(6), updated_date TIMESTAMP(6), name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT, is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, order_number INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id) );

changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP(6), updated_date TIMESTAMP(6), stop_factor_id BIGINT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, value_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, result VARCHAR(255), PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (stop_factor_id) REFERENCES stop_factors.stop_factor (id), UNIQUE (stop_factor_id, result), CHECK (value_type IN ('STRING', 'INTEGER', 'DOUBLE', 'ARRAY')), CHECK (result IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'UNDERWRITER')) );

changeSet.author: aaltynbek
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_check ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_date TIMESTAMP(6), updated_date TIMESTAMP(6), scoring_id BIGINT NOT NULL, stop_factor_id BIGINT NOT NULL, checked_value TEXT NOT NULL, result VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY (stop_factor_id) REFERENCES stop_factors.stop_factor (id), CHECK (result IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'UNDERWRITER')) );
CREATE INDEX idx_stop_factor_check_scoring_id ON stop_factors.stop_factor_check (scoring_id);
